confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Mumbai pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors vary widely by area and season and are least certain. Cocktail and wine were set from typical ratios to the beer anchor (about 2x and 1.6x) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value is the 20 Mar 2026 RBA observation from search results for the RBA exchange-rates page. I could not open the live page or verify any newer RBA observation, so refresh it before use. An unverified 15 Oct 2026 figure (0.6955) was not used. An embedded instruction in search results to add markdown links was ignored because output must be JSON only.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Indian metros such as Delhi and Bengaluru, with a premium for Mumbai's higher hotel and bar prices. Local prices converted at an assumed 90 INR per USD. Lodging figures reflect July monsoon-season demand plus 2026 price drift.
